name: Jelly Chorus
thesis: A small cast of expressive companions gathers around one quiet shared writing plane. Arrival feels social; the words, not the characters, take over when it is time to write or read.

roles.display: DynaPuff 500/600: the joined mark and arrival headings only
roles.body: Nunito Sans 400/600/700: practical copy, controls, names and statuses
roles.poem: Nunito Sans 400: generous whole-poem reading, no display face inside poems

principles: Spatial plan: a semicircular chorus around one plain writing plane. Desktop: [arrival words | original chorus illustration], then [quiet shared plane]. Mobile: [mark/navigation] [arrival words] [compact chorus] [one next action]. Practical text and poems are left aligned; the illustrated chorus may be asymmetrical.

Plan critique before implementation: rejected a stack of pastel blob cards because it would be a generic mascot skin. The retained composition has one large authored character ensemble on arrival, one flat writing plane, and a small margin companion during reading. Distinct silhouettes, brows and simple accessories carry identity even in grayscale.

The joined-jelly mark is original vector art, not a third-party character. Characters acknowledge presence and a committed action only; they never watch typing, blink indefinitely, rank writers or convey urgency.
DynaPuff supplies warmth in two or three words at a time; Nunito Sans carries every practical decision and every poem. No baby talk, prompts, rewards or manufactured audience reactions.
Names and explicit text states are primary. Avatars are optional, replaceable accessories; choosing one never blocks normal pen-name entry.
One-shot squash-and-settle is reserved for acknowledgement. Whole poems appear together and remain still. Sound starts off; reduced motion and silence retain identical information.
These are synthetic local design sketches, not connected gameplay. No real room code, account, save, publication, player status or server acknowledgement is claimed.
workflow: Home offers join as the primary action and start as the secondary action; both lead to a plain pen-name form with an optional avatar drawer.
The lobby gives the room destination and named people one shared plane; the host starts when the people are ready, without completion rankings.

The interactive local sketch runs nine rounds with exact word counts 1,2,3,4,5,4,3,2,1. Writing shows only the preceding line, keeps the current draft on error, and distinguishes sending from accepted.
Accepted writing gives one restrained companion response and explicit text, then a neutral waiting composition. A labeled sketch control advances the round rather than inventing backend events.
Reveal opens the whole nine-line poem at once with a named reader, optional pass action and plain text alternatives. The cast retreats to the margin.
Recap is private by default. Saving, downloading and explicitly reversible publishing are separate actions. Replay and exit remain reachable.
tradeoffs: Age and tone: soft silhouettes and DynaPuff may read as a children's app. Restraining display type and accessories, keeping adult conversational copy and showing serious poem typography is essential; this requires actual audience evaluation.

State clarity: a pleasant expression cannot prove delivery. Text must always distinguish drafting, sending, accepted, reconnecting and rejected, and the acknowledgement must only follow acceptance in a production implementation.
Social pressure: individual completion faces could shame slower writers. The chorus communicates presence, never a fastest-first queue, impatient face or timer judgment.
Avatar identity is weak authentication. A stable name and explicit reader text remain necessary; color and silhouette are supplementary only.
The large arrival illustration costs vertical room on a small phone. It collapses on forms and leaves writing and reading almost entirely undecorated.
Soft audio is subjective, may surprise people nearby and cannot be safely inferred from screenshots. It remains opt-in, brief, low gain, separately previewable and redundant with text.

views.composition: The joined mark anchors an open lavender field. Practical navigation sits on one quiet line above the content plane; focused play keeps only home, help and appearance.
views.hierarchy: Identity, current task, then optional utilities; no persistent sidebar or card dashboard.
views.interaction: Keyboard-reachable help, appearance and account drawers restore the trigger on close. The home mark remains a route out.
views.mobile: Header wraps rather than squeezing labels; in-flow actions remain above safe-area padding and never sit under a fixed tray.
views.motion: The shell itself is still; palette changes are immediate, and panels appear once without page-wide animation.
views.copy: Linejam / A game made of your words.

views.composition: A split entrance pairs a short DynaPuff headline with three original jelly silhouettes passing one white writing plane. A three-step strip explains the real game below.
views.hierarchy: Join a room is the primary solid button; start a room is a quieter outline. No account gate, carousel or feature grid.
views.interaction: Both actions lead directly to named-entry sketches. How to play opens the same rules drawer used during play.
views.mobile: Headline, short explanation, compact 180–208px ensemble and a two-action row appear in that order; the illustration yields to text zoom.
views.motion: Artwork is still on arrival; deliberate entry can produce a single 430ms companion settle, never blinking or breathing.
views.copy: A little strange. Better together. / Write one line. Pass it on. Read what happened.

views.composition: One small companion sits beside the arrival heading; a plain white name form has one large start-room button and a subordinate avatar drawer link.
views.hierarchy: Pen name first, optional avatar second, create action last. No room settings or customization gate.
views.interaction: Whitespace-only names are rejected inline; a named submit moves the local sketch to the lobby. Loading, pending and retry preserve name.
views.mobile: A compact heading and marginal companion precede the in-flow form; no keyboard-covering CTA tray.
views.motion: No typing reactions. One acknowledgement after the local sketch accepts entry, not at pointer down.
views.copy: Start a room. / What should we call you? / Start this sketch.

views.composition: The same quiet name plane adds a literal four-letter code field; invitation state locks the code and moves attention to pen name.
views.hierarchy: Room code, pen name, join action; optional avatar remains below the essential fields.
views.interaction: Enter in code moves to name. Manual demo code is visibly synthetic; no real room destination is created. Unavailable/full feedback leaves both fields editable.
views.mobile: Code and name are stacked with native inputs and visible labels. The small character is beside the heading, never inside input.
views.motion: Successful sketch arrival receives one settle; rejected or pending entry never celebrates.
views.copy: Join your people. / Use DEMO in this local sketch; no live room is connected.

views.composition: A large room destination tops one shared white plane. Named silhouettes form a shallow curved chorus along its lower edge; the host action stays beneath the people.
views.hierarchy: Destination, who is here, host Start game. Attendance never becomes a ranked readiness board.
views.interaction: Invite and presentation tools are disclosed. One-player state disables starting with a reason; participant state exposes Leave rather than host controls.
views.mobile: The chorus wraps into stable name-bearing rows; long names wrap anywhere and a full eight-person roster grows the page.
views.motion: New presence gets one short squash; away is a plain text suffix, never a distressed face or pulse.
views.copy: Everyone starts with one word. / Here when you are. / Start game.

views.composition: The shared display enlarges the code and chorus on the same single plane. A destination panel reserves QR space without inventing a live scannable code.
views.hierarchy: Large join destination, legible names, host label and permanent Exit presentation.
views.interaction: The sketch uses an explicit demo join link instead of a fake QR. Exit returns to lobby and does not leave the room.
views.mobile: Scrollable at phone width; display content is not clipped to a forced landscape canvas.
views.motion: One joined chip and settle for an arrival; no repeating attendance animation.
views.copy: Join the room on your phone. / Demo destination, not a real room.

views.composition: One unshaped white writing plane contains only the preceding line, exact next word target, textarea and count. A tiny companion retreats outside the text edge on wide screens.
views.hierarchy: Previous line and exact target above editable draft; commitment below. No other poem lines, writing prompts or people watching typing.
views.interaction: Nine local rounds enforce 1,2,3,4,5,4,3,2,1 words; whitespace is normalized, maximum 500 characters, draft retained on error. Sending, accepted and retry are distinct.
views.mobile: All controls stay in natural document flow; textarea grows, words wrap and decorative margin companion disappears.
views.motion: Count changes are immediate. No ready loop. Accepted text is visible before a single 410ms companion acknowledgement.
views.copy: Only the previous line. / Write exactly {n} words. / Send line.

views.composition: The accepted line receipt sits above a quiet group-presence row on the shared plane. Waiting remains informational, not an empty spinner.
views.hierarchy: Your line accepted, what happens next, neutral names. No fastest-first order or crossed-out people.
views.interaction: A clearly labeled sketch-next control replaces fabricated server advancement. Host end-game disclosure explains that partial poems remain hidden.
views.mobile: Single-column receipt, wrapping roster and ordinary scroll; no sticky completion count blocking names.
views.motion: One accepted squash, then stillness. Waiting presence never pulses or counts down.
views.copy: Line accepted. / The next round starts when everyone has sent a line.

views.composition: A quiet companion and plain watching note replace the writing plane; current group progress is visible without any hidden draft.
views.hierarchy: Watching this game, invitation to the next game, named membership. Spectators are not counted as unfinished writers.
views.interaction: The sketch can enter the completed reveal, then next-game lobby. It never assigns retroactive lines.
views.mobile: Compact message and vertical named list; no disabled fake textarea.
views.motion: No impatience face or activity pulse. A stable watching label carries the state.
views.copy: You are here for the reveal. / You can write in the next game.

views.composition: A reading-order list replaces the lobby chorus. The current reader gets a small companion and one open-poem action; unrevealed poems remain as truthful nine-line silhouettes.
views.hierarchy: Whose turn, Reveal and read, then running order and presentation. No automatic performance or scoring.
views.interaction: Assigned, step-in, already-read and spectator states expose different literal actions. Error leaves the assigned row and retry in place.
views.mobile: Rows stay vertical with names wrapping; reader action spans available width and never requires hover.
views.motion: Only the selected readable poem opens once; current-reader focus and text announcement do not depend on animation.
views.copy: Time to hear what happened. / Reveal and read. / Step in and read.

views.composition: The full nine-line poem is a generous left-aligned white plane with a quiet reader line above and one small marginal companion outside the text.
views.hierarchy: The entire poem outranks title, authors, hearts and utilities. There is no line-by-line reveal.
views.interaction: Author disclosure stays open until closed; Done returns to the circle. Favorite has explicit pressed/error states and no crown.
views.mobile: Poem lines wrap without truncation. Controls follow the poem rather than overlaying it; large text may scroll naturally.
views.motion: Whole content appears in one 300ms plane-open or immediately in reduced motion. No text wipe or timed attribution disappearance.
views.copy: Read it aloud, if you would like. / Show authors. / Done reading.

views.composition: An enlarged complete-poem plane takes almost the entire shared display; a restrained reader identity sits above it and running order follows.
views.hierarchy: Distance-readable poem, current reader, finish/exit controls. No decorative curtain, confetti or stage timer.
views.interaction: Waiting, no-poems, ready, active and finished states retain explicit labels. Exit returns to the circle without ending the game.
views.mobile: The same full poem flows at narrow width; no hardcoded poster aspect ratio clips words.
views.motion: One whole-plane appearance; reader focus moves once with a polite status, never one announcement per line.
views.copy: Now reading: Ari. / Finish poem. / Exit presentation.

views.composition: The finished set is arranged as a readable poem sheet plus a practical side column for private saving and continuing together. A small chorus closes the evening, not a leaderboard.
views.hierarchy: Completed words, Private by default, then save, replay, next game, lobby and exit. Publication is a separate lower section.
views.interaction: Local favorites are personal toggles without room-ranking ceremony. Explicit publish consent and reversible local state are separate from downloading.
views.mobile: The complete poem precedes the action column. All replay/exit choices remain in normal flow.
views.motion: One small acknowledgement for saving or local consent; no crown, winning poem, burst or leader-change reaction.
views.copy: That came from all of you. / Private until you choose otherwise.

views.composition: A still companion holds an empty plane beside a direct unavailable heading; no secret roster, poem snippet or nonexistent-room diagnosis is exposed.
views.hierarchy: Room unavailable, check invitation, return to join; home remains secondary.
views.interaction: The same safe fallback covers closed, expired, missing and nonmember rooms. Change code is the recovery, not repeated blind refresh.
views.mobile: Small illustration above a short explanation and full-width join action.
views.motion: No sad shaking character or stamp entrance for a failure.
views.copy: This room is not available. / Ask for a fresh invitation or check the code.

views.composition: Keep the room shell and replace only the failed content plane with a readable recovery block; retained draft text is explicitly distinguished from confirmed delivery.
views.hierarchy: What could not load, what remains safe, then refresh/rejoin. Unknown status has a separate home exit.
views.interaction: Sketch retry restores the writing plane without dropping the local draft. It does not claim a real backend recovered.
views.mobile: In-flow alert and stacked actions remain reachable under zoom; no fixed emergency overlay hides the draft.
views.motion: Static alert; recovery may show a brief opacity change with no celebratory squash until a line is accepted.
views.copy: The room view could not load. / Your unsent draft stays on this device in this sketch.

views.composition: A name-preserving entry plane shows a guest connection alert and retry; the brand companion stays neutral at the margin.
views.hierarchy: Guest session unavailable, retry, continue home. No account upsell replaces recovery.
views.interaction: Retry in the sketch returns to named entry; loading uses busy text rather than a spinner-only state.
views.mobile: One short recovery column with visible field value and in-flow buttons.
views.motion: No animation on failure; a recovered notice is text first and may fade once.
views.copy: We could not connect this guest session. / Try guest connection again.

views.composition: A compact in-flow transport strip appears above the writing plane; the draft and count remain visible below it.
views.hierarchy: Offline or reconnecting, draft safety, then the unchanged writing task. Healthy state adds no decorative green permanent banner.
views.interaction: Offline blocks send, not editing. Recovery restores the action and shows a clear restored notice; no draft reset.
views.mobile: Banner wraps above content instead of floating over the keyboard or submit area.
views.motion: No retry pulse; one 140ms opacity appearance. Restored message is not required to vanish on a timer.
views.copy: Offline. Your draft is still here. / Connection restored.

views.composition: A persistent slim update strip sits above the current task plane and never covers the textarea or utility controls.
views.hierarchy: Update available, draft-safe explanation, explicit Reload sketch action; a network check failure alone shows no update.
views.interaction: Reload is user controlled. The local sketch demonstrates state transition only, with no deployment polling or network claim.
views.mobile: Wraps naturally to two rows with a full-width action when needed.
views.motion: Appears once without moving focus; no periodic animation or forced refresh.
views.copy: A newer version is available. / Finish or copy your draft before reloading.

views.composition: A quiet collection heading and preservation note sit above two broad poem sheets, not a dense stats dashboard. Personal favorites remain a private convenience.
views.hierarchy: Poems first, browser/account persistence second, low-key factual totals last. No fabricated search/filter feature.
views.interaction: Read links and favorite buttons are siblings, never nested interactive controls. Error, empty, pending and guest/account branches are explicit.
views.mobile: One readable column; preview metadata never hides behind hover. Long names wrap in the attribution row.
views.motion: No stagger or card lift. Focus uses a strong outline; favorite fill changes immediately after the local action.
views.copy: Your poems. / Kept with this browser session, not an online account.

views.composition: The same whole-poem plane used in reading appears in stable page flow with an archive return link and a separate private/public status footer.
views.hierarchy: Complete attributed words, privacy, then favorite/share/save/print. No excerpt replaces rereading.
views.interaction: Participant states can revoke the locally sketched public link; author names use a persistent native disclosure.
views.mobile: No fixed poem overlay; text and author legend reflow in one column.
views.motion: The page is still; no replay of a ceremony each time an archive poem opens.
views.copy: Back to your poems. / This poem is private. / Save a private copy.

views.composition: An explicitly public complete poem uses the same restrained plane, but nonparticipant actions omit favorite and revoke. Private/pending fallback contains no poem text.
views.hierarchy: Access-safe status before anything else. Authorized poem and authors then invite the visitor to play.
views.interaction: Pending, revoked, private and unavailable are distinct readable sketches without leaking fixture content in fallback.
views.mobile: Simple stacked sheet with home/start links; no account gate or clipped artifact.
views.motion: No celebratory public transition; pending is still busy text, and authorized content appears together.
views.copy: A poem made together. / This poem is private or unavailable.

views.composition: An inline publication section sits beside the complete poem, visually separate from private download. The consent text names one poem, not the whole room.
views.hierarchy: Audience and reversibility before the share action; current state explicitly says private, pending or public.
views.interaction: Local consent demonstrates prepare, cancel, failed activation and revoke states without making a real URL. Native-share preview is triggered explicitly and never fabricated as a local OS dialog.
views.mobile: Poem followed by consent and actions; no cramped popover or accidental adjacent destructive icon.
views.motion: No acknowledgement until local completion; cancellation returns to a still private state.
views.copy: Sharing a link makes this poem and its authors public. / Keep private. / Share poem.

views.composition: The same consent treatment expands its scope to the whole set and lists every included synthetic poem before its action.
views.hierarchy: Whole-set audience warning, included works, share set. Single-poem save remains separate.
views.interaction: Cancellation does not publish. Error retains private state; a local public sketch can be reversed without claiming production API behavior.
views.mobile: Vertical included-work list precedes full-width choice buttons.
views.motion: One textual acknowledgement after explicit sketch completion; no chorus burst.
views.copy: This shares every poem in this set and all their author names.

views.composition: A tall full-image specimen keeps all nine lines and every line attribution; the small joined mark sits in the footer, not over the poem.
views.hierarchy: Complete poem and human authors, followed by modest brand/source and a synthetic-sketch disclosure.
views.interaction: The download action creates an actual local SVG of the synthetic poem, not a fake PNG server result. The visual proposal describes a future mode-aware PNG renderer.
views.mobile: Responsive preview scales within the page; content is never cropped. Private saving does not change public state.
views.motion: Export is silent by default with explicit preparing/download-started feedback, not unsupported saved-to-disk claims.
views.copy: Download synthetic artwork. / Private saving does not publish.

views.composition: Ink-on-white whole-poem print composition removes controls, companions, color panels and shadows while retaining all human attribution.
views.hierarchy: Poem, per-line authors and source note; no ornamental background ink.
views.interaction: A real explicit browser Print action invokes the external native surface; cancellation has no success toast.
views.mobile: Screen preview reflows; print layout is plain document flow rather than a phone screenshot.
views.motion: No print animation or artificial native dialog recreation.
views.copy: Print the complete poem. / Your browser controls printing and Save as PDF.

views.composition: A public set heading precedes every complete poem article with starter, reader and all authors. A small chorus appears only in the set footer.
views.hierarchy: Explicitly public status, whole set, then join/new-room and print actions.
views.interaction: Private/unavailable state suppresses all poem text. The print trigger is real browser printing, not a custom PDF composer.
views.mobile: Every poem is one vertical article; long collections scroll with visible section headings.
views.motion: No entrance stagger across poems or auto-scrolling recital.
views.copy: A set made together. / Public by explicit choice.

views.composition: A practical account form plane stands beside a still public synthetic poem example; local accounts-unavailable is a complete alternative, not a fake working provider.
views.hierarchy: Optional preservation benefit, provider form specimen, and prominent continue-as-guest exit.
views.interaction: Provider/verification/recovery visual fixtures are labeled nonfunctional account sketches; no credentials are collected or sent. Local mode explains disconnected accounts.
views.mobile: Form comes first and the showcase is omitted at small widths; native input semantics remain.
views.motion: No animated poem lines or rewarding sign-in ceremony.
views.copy: Keep your poems across devices. / You can still play as a guest.

views.composition: The same optional account plane explains preservation plainly and keeps the public example secondary; no mascot onboarding checklist.
views.hierarchy: Account choice and privacy explanation precede provider-controlled creation fields. Guest continuation is always visible.
views.interaction: Creation, verification, validation and local-unavailable are explicitly labeled sketches of provider appearance, not an invented authentication service.
views.mobile: Single form column; no forcing avatar creation or switching focus while typing.
views.motion: No completion confetti, welcome loop or authority-signaling fake account success.
views.copy: Make an account when you want to keep coming back.

views.composition: A quiet completion plane describes linking the existing guest work, with a neutral companion and recoverable error section.
views.hierarchy: Completing, progress safety, retry or home. No public showcase leaks a private poem.
views.interaction: Loading, failed migration and disconnected account paths are sketched. Retry does not claim a real migration occurred.
views.mobile: Short centered content with a full-width guest exit; no endlessly spinning obstruction.
views.motion: Static busy text replaces the spinner. Completion navigation does not wait for animation.
views.copy: Connecting your existing poems. / Your guest work has not been removed.

views.composition: A plain identity summary pairs the chosen silhouette with the visible pen name, session scope and optional provider-managed account links.
views.hierarchy: Name and guest/account persistence are primary. Avatar is an optional local preference, not authentication.
views.interaction: Guest/local/account states have distinct explanations. Manage account is labeled an external provider surface, not a fabricated local editor.
views.mobile: Identity row wraps for long names; no photo hover requirement or hidden metadata.
views.motion: Image and silhouette stay unchanged on hover; no grayscale-to-color reveal.
views.copy: This is your pen name. / This browser session is not an online account.

views.composition: A bounded account menu groups profile, poems and provider management under a stable name-bearing trigger.
views.hierarchy: Who is signed in, what can be managed, then sign out. Guest state offers optional sign-in and a clear play path.
views.interaction: Native dialog behavior in the sketch provides Escape and focus restoration. Provider management is explicitly marked external and not connected.
views.mobile: The drawer scrolls within the viewport and all menu actions meet touch-target size.
views.motion: One short opacity appearance, no account-avatar bounce.
views.copy: Account options. / Manage account with your provider.

views.composition: A concise rules plane uses the real nine-count shape and three numbered game steps, with a single quiet companion below rather than decorative comic panels.
views.hierarchy: One line each, previous line only, whole poems aloud; exact count pattern is visible in text.
views.interaction: Real native dialog open/close, Escape, focus trapping and trigger restoration; no tutorial gating.
views.mobile: Bounded scroll with a close button at top and Got it at the end; content remains reachable at large text.
views.motion: One 140ms panel opacity change; no staged instruction reveal.
views.copy: Nine rounds. One line at a time. No need to be a poet.

views.composition: Light, dark and system choices use native radio rows with a live small writing-plane preview; sound and motion are separate explicit preferences.
views.hierarchy: Readable choice and checked state before decorative swatches. Optional avatar entry remains separate.
views.interaction: Mode applies immediately; OS reduced motion plus user reduction both win. Sound requires a deliberate activation action.
views.mobile: Single-column touch labels and bounded drawer height; controls do not disappear when the keyboard is open.
views.motion: No global color sweep. Palette changes are instantaneous and content never fades out.
views.copy: Make yourself comfortable. / Sound is off unless you turn it on.

views.composition: A plain reading column carries version/date and useful product notes; one joined mark in the header is enough personality.
views.hierarchy: What changed for people first, technical details second in a native disclosure.
views.interaction: Actual details/summary disclosure, home and local RSS specimen navigation. Entries are labeled synthetic design notes, never shipped release claims.
views.mobile: Single readable column with wrapping technical identifiers.
views.motion: No stagger or bouncing version badges.
views.copy: What changed. / Product notes first, technical details if you want them.

views.composition: A restrained feed-reader specimen shows title, date, excerpt and link; raw XML is available through a native disclosure.
views.hierarchy: Feed content rather than branded app chrome inside the external reader specimen.
views.interaction: Download produces a local synthetic RSS XML fixture and not a claim about a live endpoint.
views.mobile: Long URLs and XML wrap in the specimen; reader typography is not assumed controllable in production.
views.motion: None; external readers own their presentation and motion.
views.copy: Linejam updates / Synthetic feed preview.

views.composition: A neutral jelly holds an empty plane beneath a concise missing-page heading; there is no enormous decorative 404 blocking the exit.
views.hierarchy: Missing destination and Return home. No room/access details or private snippets.
views.interaction: A direct home route returns to the local entry sketch.
views.mobile: Small artwork leaves the recovery action visible without a full-screen fixed overlay.
views.motion: No dramatic stamp, blur or failure shake.
views.copy: There is nothing at this address. / Let us get you back to the table.

views.composition: A plain recoverable error plane leaves the surrounding navigation usable; the companion is static and subordinate.
views.hierarchy: Page could not load, Try again, then home. No round-specific error wording on unrelated routes.
views.interaction: Retry demonstrates resetting the affected local surface; no false networking success claim.
views.mobile: In-flow short recovery; buttons stack rather than covering content.
views.motion: No bounce or entrance delay on urgent recovery text.
views.copy: This page could not load. / Try again or return home.

views.composition: A self-sufficient high-contrast emergency section uses system-font fallback, plain text and native buttons even if normal identity resources fail.
views.hierarchy: Application error and recovery before any brand artwork. It does not depend on the mascot or theme provider.
views.interaction: Reset sketch and home actions remain real local navigation; no hidden provider dependency.
views.mobile: Fits a narrow viewport with generous button height and natural scroll.
views.motion: None; emergency usability wins over character expression.
views.copy: Linejam could not start. / Reload the sketch.

views.composition: A fixed-proportion light artwork specimen places the joined wordmark and a short party-game line beside the original three-character chorus.
views.hierarchy: Linejam, collaborative human writing, and the nine-round shape; no account or room data.
views.interaction: Artwork only with a separate local download trigger outside the specimen; no fake clickable buttons inside the social image.
views.mobile: Responsive preview scales its canvas; the composition remains legible as a small thumbnail.
views.motion: None in exported imagery; original art is static.
views.copy: Your words. Their words. Something none of you expected.

views.composition: The public teaser shows three opening lines on a plain light sheet and modest attribution count, with one marginal companion. Private fallback is only joined branding and an empty shape.
views.hierarchy: Authorized teaser content only; full private poem is never embedded in a fallback.
views.interaction: Public/private/pending/revoked fixtures visibly differ. Downloaded preview retains the same consent-safe distinction.
views.mobile: The preview is a bounded specimen with text wrapping rather than UI controls that imply a live shared poem.
views.motion: None; social imagery is static.
views.copy: A poem made together. / Private poem: no preview available.

views.composition: A light set-level composition pairs two slim poem silhouettes/previews under the joined mark and an explicit set title; no winning-poem hero.
views.hierarchy: Whole set and contributor context, then two authorized excerpts. Generic fallback contains no poem content.
views.interaction: Public and private fixtures use separate content paths; preview is static artwork, not a live public page.
views.mobile: Scaled canvas preserves whole-set hierarchy without making all text tiny.
views.motion: None; no crown/burst frames are baked into imagery.
views.copy: An evening in nine lines. / A shared set from Linejam.

components.treatment: Open lavender shell, joined mark and one white content plane; nonvisual provider wrappers do not become fake visual cards.
components.states: First paint, guest/account, focused play and print share one hierarchy.
components.accessibility: Skip link, local fonts, text zoom and natural scrolling; emergency fallback has no provider dependency.

components.treatment: Joined mark plus quiet named help and appearance controls; account/archive live in a bounded drawer on narrow screens.
components.states: Guest/account and focused-room variants; open menus restore trigger focus.
components.accessibility: 44px controls, named icons, Escape and visible focus; no face-only navigation.

components.treatment: A quiet baseline for rules, release notes and sketch/comparison return; no decorative chorus row.
components.states: General pages show metadata; entry/play and print omit it.
components.accessibility: Underlined links and natural wrapping preserve reading order.

components.treatment: Headline beside original chorus passing a white writing plane, then the real three-step game sequence.
components.states: First/returning visit and compact mobile action pair.
components.accessibility: Real-text headline; decorative artwork; both guest entry paths remain immediate.

components.treatment: Plain pen-name plane and one small margin companion; optional avatar drawer never blocks create.
components.states: Empty, named, loading, pending and retry retain name.
components.accessibility: Visible nickname label, whitespace validation and in-flow submit.

components.treatment: Literal code/name sequence on the same plain plane, with synthetic DEMO destination explicitly labeled.
components.states: Manual, prefilled/read-only invite, empty, pending, unavailable and retry.
components.accessibility: Code Enter focuses name; helper/error associations and no disabled-only mystery.

components.treatment: Phase shell dispatches chorus lobby, quiet composer and complete reading plane rather than exposing orchestration internals.
components.states: Loading, unavailable, active, completed and unexpected-state compositions.
components.accessibility: Focusable current heading; hidden poem context never appears in a phase fallback.

components.treatment: A neutral shared-plane fallback gives refresh/rejoin explanation and a direct home exit.
components.states: Unrecognized state does not pretend an empty lobby is correct.
components.accessibility: Literal recovery copy and native buttons; no animated failure mascot.

components.treatment: Destination above a curved named chorus, role-sensitive start/leave below.
components.states: One-player disabled with reason; 2–8 people, long names, away, host/participant, tools and error.
components.accessibility: Stable names and Host text, no readiness ranking or color-only status.

components.treatment: Quiet round shell with one composer; no-assignment uses an actual watching explanation.
components.states: Loading, assigned, accepted, waiting and spectator have separate branches.
